Name: Junimo Kart Cheat Menu
Author: b1rdyw1rdy
Description:
[size=2]This mod adds a cheat menu for Junimo Kart. The cheats include infinite lives, invincibility, low/high gravity, and small/large jump heights.

In the config file, the cheats for Junimo Kart can be individually enabled/changed. I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] if you are interested in editing the config. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] installed, you can click the cog button (⚙) on the main menu or the mod settings button in the in-game settings menu to use the cheats.
[/size]
